message: You know, I’ve always been the one who forgets to charge my phone before a storm hits, leaving me scrambling for a flashlight and a good book when the power goes out. But I've been trying to turn over a new leaf and actually be prepared for once! This resource on heat safety is a great reminder to think ahead and keep cool when the weather gets wild. How do you stay prepared when the forecast looks a bit dicey? ☀️
